business_summary: Nexus Advanced Technologies Inc. engages in data centers, AI compute infrastructure, GPU infrastructure, and other technologies business. Nexus Advanced Technologies Inc. was formerly known as K Wave Media Ltd. and changed its name to Nexus Advanced Technologies Inc. in September 2026. Nexus Advanced Technologies Inc. was incorporated in 2023 and is based in George Town, Cayman Islands.
business_summary_ko: Nexus Advanced Technologies Inc.는 데이터 센터, AI 컴퓨팅 인프라, GPU 인프라 및 기타 기술 사업에 종사하고 있습니다. Nexus Advanced Technologies Inc.는 이전에 K Wave Media Ltd.로 알려졌으며 2026년 9월에 Nexus Advanced Technologies Inc.로 이름을 변경했습니다. Nexus Advanced Technologies Inc.는 2023년에 설립되었으며 케이맨 제도 조지타운에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
